notes: counted = model's share of the expected two-way votes already counted (timeline); map f = share of the municipality's polling sections received.
Count path rebuilt from each section's TSE receipt time (DT_BU_RECEBIDO + 3 h = UTC), not from the results site's publication times.

stats.settle = first time after which P (model) or the price (market) stayed >= 0.9 on the eventual winner to the end (the registered definition, night.evaluate); it can fall before 1% is counted when the prior alone already gives P >= 0.9.
Solid model lines and the headline statistics are v1. Dashed v2 lines are a sensitivity whose settings were chosen after the result was known, using only earlier elections; map projections remain v1.
Prior per state: 2026 governor first round by municipality, same two candidates.
pm = Polymarket last traded price of the YES (= candidate a) side, carried forward minute by minute.

stats.settle_gated: model = max(registered model settle, gate), gate = first minute with >= 1% counted in that race; lead = minutes from the model's gated settle to lead_vs settling (positive: model first).

sensitivities.label: tau mixture over earlier nights (chosen after the result was known)
sensitivities.note: An equal-weight mixture over the reporting-order errors that 8 earlier count nights needed (mx2012 0.015, mx2018 0.02, br2022r1 0, br2022r2 0.005, mx2024 0.03, pl2025r1 0.0075, pl2025r2 0.02, br2026r1 0.015). Same point forecast as the base model (rho 0.8, kappa 50,000); only the band and the win chance allow for those 8 different errors instead of one. Built from earlier nights only, but chosen after this result was known, so it is a sensitivity, not a forecast.
